facts.scope_guard: Possible elements and engagement options are not a quantified scheme, planning application, issued permission or delivery commitment.

scope_guards: No current Planning Data entity was invented.
The official engagement page explicitly states that there were no definite plans for new building.
Possible new homes were not converted into a dwelling number or permission status.
Play, bridge and community-space options were not counted as residential capacity.
Address ranges identify the engagement area but are not an exact red-line or HMLR title polygon.
Local Plan allocation identity does not override the early-engagement status.
A 2022 page update is not treated as evidence of a later final decision or construction event.
No score or promotion is written without a quantified current scheme, permission, exact geometry, title relation and overlays.
